promotion_gate.claim_boundary: Only PROMOTABLE closes the final Flash-Next gate. A measured candidate that misses either hard threshold remains a research/Pareto intermediate.

required_primitives: sparse expert router and index lookup

safetensors_header_audit.claim_boundary: Only safetensors headers/data_offsets were read; tensor bodies were not requested or loaded.

three_zero_questions.claim_boundary: The three zeros are questions and experiment gates, not achieved reductions.

execution.current_answer: Only conditional removal is allowed. Text-only vision and rejected speculative work may be skipped only when request mode, state, and accepted-token parity are proven.
execution.question: Can an execution path be removed to zero work without changing accepted complete-token behavior?

candidates: shared n-gram dictionary and route metadata
independent_information.current_answer: No zero-independent-information claim. Shared bases, residuals, dictionaries, and route metadata are candidates whose residual information must be measured.
independent_information.question: Can representations share or be generated so that independent information reaches zero while preserving the model function?

three_zero_questions.label: DERIVED

candidates: remove unused text-only vision storage from the active working set
storage.current_answer: No zero-storage claim. Source weights, recurrent state, cache state, and any accepted-token state remain explicit requirements or conditional costs.
storage.question: Can required persistent storage be driven to zero without deleting information or changing the accepted function?
